reason: The hypothesis directly restates the finding from P5 and P39 that adding Hf to the W-Ta-Cr-V system suppresses Cr-V precipitation by modifying short-range order, and applies it to the specific base alloy W38Ta36Cr15V11. The proposed mechanism, predicted outcome, and characterization methods are all taken from the same source, with the only addition being a generic claim about improved sinterability that is not supported by the cited passages.
